## Correlation plots for different variables

Visualizing data

```{r}
clinical_augment
```

### Cancer type and number of mutations

```{r}
ggplot(data = clinical_augment,
       mapping = aes(x = cancer_type,
                     y = number_mutations,
                     color = cancer_type)) +
  geom_jitter() +
    theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(title = "Cancer type and number of mutations", 
       subtitle = "The dots indicate how many mutations the individual patient has",
       x = "Cancer type",
       y = "Number of mutations") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

### Status and gender, colored by age group

```{r}
ggplot(data = clinical_augment,
       mapping = aes(x = status,
                     y = sex,
                     color = age_group))+
  scale_size_area(max_size = 20)+
  geom_count(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
             alpha = 0.8)+
  labs(size = "Count",
       x = "Patient status",
       y = "Gender") 
```
